title: Why Read Poems?
text:
Poems are short texts that often focus on a single moment or feeling. A poet may use rhythm, rhyme and vivid images to make readers notice small details. Because poems are compact, every line and word tends to carry extra meaning. Readers often need to read a poem slowly and more than once.

Many students find poetry difficult at first, because it does not always explain itself. However, a teacher can help by asking questions about the images and the mood. Over time, students often learn to notice patterns and connections they missed before. For this reason, many schools include poetry in their literature courses.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what do poems often focus on?
According to the second paragraph, why do many students find poetry difficult at first?
options: It is always written in very long lines
It does not always explain itself
It is never taught in schools
It has no images at all

questions.text: What can be inferred about the way a reader should approach a poem?
options: Quickly, so that it can be finished in one reading
Slowly, and possibly more than once
Only by listening to someone else read it
Without paying attention to the words

questions.text: What does the passage suggest about a teacher's role in poetry lessons?
options: To replace the poem with a summary
To guide students to notice images and mood
To give students the answers without questions

vocabulary.definition: containing a lot of meaning in a small space
producing strong and clear pictures in the mind
the feeling or atmosphere that a text creates
regular or repeated features that can be recognised

paragraph_translations: Вірші - це короткі тексти, які часто зосереджені на одному моменті або почутті. Поет може використовувати ритм, риму та яскраві образи, щоб читачі помічали дрібні деталі. Оскільки вірші стислі, кожен рядок і кожне слово часто несуть додатковий зміст. Читачам часто потрібно читати вірш повільно і більше ніж один раз.

Багатьом студентам поезія спочатку видається складною, бо вона не завжди пояснює сама себе. Проте вчитель може допомогти, ставлячи запитання про образи та настрій. З часом студенти часто навчаються помічати закономірності та зв'язки, які раніше пропускали. Саме тому багато шкіл включають поезію до своїх курсів літератури.
